title: PR body redesign: reviewer-first structure and attribution removal

completion_criteria.text: A non-ambiguous SPEC is authored and placed, covering body reorder, attribution removal, the sentence-form rule, and an explicit filed-items list
All AI/agent/model attribution is removed from the PR tool and made permanent by a source-level census test
The body renders in the reviewer-first order with the sentence-form rule enforced on the fields the SPEC names
The unenforceable readability rules land in the prose layer: agent prompt fixtures, the pr skill, and the global PR rule doc
Both PR tool test files pass with the golden-body test rewritten rather than deleted

spine.active_goal: Rebuild the pull request body composer to lead with what changed, read as plain sentences, and carry no agent or model attribution.
spine.next_step: START HERE IN A FRESH SESSION. Read the specification at docs/superpowers/specs/2026-08-19-reviewer-first-pr-body-composer.md end to end, then execute it exactly as written. No open questions remain and nothing needs re-deciding. Begin at section 5.1, the format module, and land each numbered subsection as its own commit. The branch docs/pr-body-reviewer-first-spec already holds the specification.
spine.last_session: Audited the tool against the owner's three concerns, recorded decisions 0631 and 0632, and authored, placed and committed the executable specification. No production code changed.

open_risks.text: Land this change only when no unit is mid-ship — every currently open tool-composed pull request stops matching the new reuse detector, so its unit parks until a human confirms or reopens it.

Stop and raise it if the attribution census fires on an unrelated use of the word provenance — adding an exception converts a closed census into an allowlist and destroys what makes the removal permanent.

key_decisions.title: Remove all agent and model attribution from PR bodies, reversing 0597
Compose PR bodies what-first, with a typographic sentence rule and no opening summary

out_of_scope: The seven follow-ups filed in the specification, including the continuous-integration boundary validator and the checkbox hardening
Grammar, readability scoring, jargon detection and identifier spotting — declared permanently unenforceable in code
The decomposer data-model change that would give a unit a summary distinct from its title
